segments.text: Why does the casino never lose? The law of large numbers.
segments.caption: Why does the casino never lose? The law of large numbers.

segments.text: The tiny edge, a coin experiment, the law, real-life uses, and the gambler's mistake. Save this one!
segments.caption: The tiny edge, a coin experiment, the law, real-life uses, and the gambler's mistake. Save this one!

segments.text: Every night in Goa, someone walks out of a casino with lakhs in their pocket.
segments.caption: Every night in Goa, someone walks out of a casino with lakhs in their pocket.

segments.text: Yet the casino itself never loses. Not this month. Not this year.
segments.caption: Yet the casino itself never loses. Not this month. Not this year.

segments.text: Is the game rigged? No. It's just maths.
segments.caption: Is the game rigged? No. It's just maths.

segments.text: Take roulette. The wheel has thirty-seven pockets: eighteen red, eighteen black, and one green zero.
segments.caption: Take roulette. The wheel has 37 pockets: 18 red, 18 black, and one green zero.

segments.text: Bet on red: eighteen out of thirty-seven. A 48.6 percent chance.
segments.caption: Bet on red: 18 out of 37. A 48.6% chance.

segments.text: The casino wins the other 51.4 percent. That one green zero gives the house an edge of just 2.7 percent.
segments.caption: The casino wins the other 51.4%. That one green zero gives the house an edge of just 2.7%.

segments.text: So for every hundred rupees bet, the casino keeps about two rupees seventy, on average.
segments.caption: So for every Rs 100 bet, the casino keeps about Rs 2.70, on average.

scenes.title: One player vs millions of spins

segments.text: For you, one night is pure luck. You might win five spins in a row and go home rich.
segments.caption: For you, one night is pure luck. You might win five spins in a row and go home rich.

segments.text: But the casino isn't playing one night. It's playing millions of spins. And over millions of spins, luck stops mattering.
segments.caption: But the casino isn't playing one night. It's playing millions of spins. And over millions of spins, luck stops mattering.

segments.text: Let's prove it with a fair coin. The true chance of heads is fifty percent.
segments.caption: Let's prove it with a fair coin. The true chance of heads is 50%.

segments.text: Ten flips: seven heads. Seventy percent. Way off.
segments.caption: 10 flips: 7 heads. 70%. Way off.

segments.text: A hundred flips: fifty-four percent. Closer.
segments.caption: 100 flips: 54%. Closer.

segments.text: A thousand: 50.8 percent. Ten thousand: 50.1 percent.
That's the law of large numbers.
segments.caption: That's the law of large numbers.

segments.text: As the number of trials grows, the average result gets closer and closer to the expected value.
segments.caption: As the number of trials grows, the average result gets closer and closer to the expected value.

segments.text: In interview language: the sample mean converges to the population mean as the sample size grows.
segments.caption: In interview language: the sample mean converges to the population mean as the sample size grows.

segments.text: Say the casino takes ten lakh bets of a hundred rupees in a year. That's ten crore rupees bet.
segments.caption: Say the casino takes 10 lakh bets of Rs 100 in a year. That's Rs 10 crore bet.

segments.text: The edge says it keeps 2.7 percent: twenty-seven lakh rupees.
segments.caption: The edge says it keeps 2.7%: Rs 27 lakh.

segments.text: And with that many bets, its real profit lands between about twenty-five and twenty-nine lakh, almost every time.
segments.caption: And with that many bets, its real profit lands between about Rs 25 and 29 lakh, almost every time.

segments.text: Short term, it's luck. Long term, it's maths.
segments.caption: Short term, it's luck. Long term, it's maths.

segments.text: This law runs real life too.
segments.caption: This law runs real life too.

segments.text: Insurance: nobody knows which driver will crash, but across ten lakh drivers, the company knows almost exactly how many will. That sets your premium.
segments.caption: Insurance: nobody knows which driver will crash, but across 10 lakh drivers, the company knows almost exactly how many will. That sets your premium.

segments.text: Cricket: a batting average after three innings means nothing. After a hundred innings, it shows who the player really is.
segments.caption: Cricket: a batting average after 3 innings means nothing. After 100 innings, it shows who the player really is.

segments.text: Ratings: five stars from three reviews? Don't trust it. 4.6 stars from five thousand reviews is the real picture.
segments.caption: Ratings: 5 stars from 3 reviews? Don't trust it. 4.6 stars from 5,000 reviews is the real picture.

segments.text: But here's the trap. After five reds in a row, people bet on black: it's due.
segments.caption: But here's the trap. After five reds in a row, people bet on black: it's due.

segments.text: It isn't. The wheel has no memory. Every spin is still 48.6 percent.
segments.caption: It isn't. The wheel has no memory. Every spin is still 48.6%.

segments.text: The average evens out, not because the wheel corrects itself, but because millions of new spins drown out the old ones. That's the gambler's fallacy.
segments.caption: The average evens out, not because the wheel corrects itself, but because millions of new spins drown out the old ones. That's the gambler's fallacy.

segments.text: So remember: small samples can lie. Large samples tell the truth.
segments.caption: So remember: small samples can lie. Large samples tell the truth.
